r13_contract.comparisonModel: If the structure is evaluated based on non-linear calculation methods, the following are to be considered: (1) The analysis is to reliably capture buckling and plastic deformation of the structure (2) The acceptance criteria are to ensure a suitable margin against fracture and major buckling and yielding causing significant loss of stiffness (3) Permanent lateral and out-of plane deformation of considered member are to be minor relative to the relevant structural dimensions No numerical minor-deformation ratio is supplied; require the explicit assessment result and evidence, not an invented threshold.

r13_contract.verificationPolicyBasis: Source/formalism-driven R8 policy; classification was not derived from model success or failure.

test_cases.rationale: Nonlinear calculation has complete margins, deformation quantities, explicit assessment and evidence.
Linear calculation does not activate I2-065 nonlinear readiness requirements.
Nonlinear case is missing acceptance evidence.
Minor permanent-deformation assessment is explicitly false.
Permanent lateral deformation quantity is missing.
Permanent out-of-plane deformation quantity is missing.
Nonlinear acceptance evidence is attached to wrong owner.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
